import os,sys,glob
_d=os.path.dirname;_e=os.path.expanduser
_g=sys.argv[1] if len(sys.argv)>1 else ''
_c=[os.path.abspath(_g)]+[os.path.join(os.environ.get(v,''),'mcp','phone_mcp.py') for v in ('PLUGIN_ROOT','MINIMAX_PLUGIN_ROOT') if os.environ.get(v)]
_c+=sorted(glob.glob(os.path.join(_e('~/.minimax'),'**','phone-use*','mcp','phone_mcp.py'),recursive=True))

_p is None and sys.exit('phone-use: cannot locate mcp/phone_mcp.py; tried '+', '.join(_c))
sys.argv=[_p];sys.path.insert(0,_d(_p));exec(compile(open(_p,encoding='utf-8').read(),_p,'exec'),{'__name__':'__main__','__file__':_p,'__package__':None})
